tools.name: search_loads
tools.description: Search active freight loads (cargo looking for a truck) on Ariberi. Give from_city, to_city or both. Returns route, cargo, body type, weight, price if stated, road distance, loading date, posting time and a url of the load on ariberi.com (the shipper's phone opens there after sign-in). Newest first.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: List routes that currently have active loads on Ariberi, busiest first, with the number of loads and a url of the route page. Optionally filter by from_city or to_city.
